# group size
all_data["group_size"] = all_data.groupby("group_id")["group_id"].transform("count")

# Title extraction from Name
all_data["title"] = all_data["Name"].str.extract(r" ([A-Za-z]+)\.")
all_data["title"] = all_data["title"].fillna("NoTitle")
title_counts = all_data["title"].value_counts()
all_data["title"] = all_data["title"].apply(
    lambda t: t if title_counts[t] >= 10 else "Other"
)

# deck + side interaction
all_data["deck_side"] = all_data["deck"] + "_" + all_data["side"]

# Amenity spending totals and ratios
spending_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
all_data["TotalSpending"] = all_data[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
for col in spending_cols:
    all_data[f"{col}_ratio"] = np.where(
        all_data["TotalSpending"] > 0,
        all_data[col] / all_data["TotalSpending"],
        0.0,
    )
all_data["HasSpending"] = (all_data["TotalSpending"] > 0).astype(int)

# drop original identifiers and free text that we no longer need
drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "Cabin", "Name"]
all_data.drop(columns=drop_cols, inplace=True, errors="ignore")

# ------------------------------ imputation ------------------------------
numeric_cols = (
    [
        "Age",
        "RoomService",
        "FoodCourt",
        "ShoppingMall",
        "Spa",
        "VRDeck",
        "cabin_num",
        "passenger_num",
        "group_size",
        "TotalSpending",
    ]
    + [f"{col}_ratio" for col in spending_cols]
    + ["HasSpending"]
)

for col in numeric_cols:
    median_val = all_data[col].median()
    all_data[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)

# categorical columns (will be target-encoded later, but also used as categorical features)
cat_cols_str = [
    "HomePlanet",
    "CryoSleep",
    "Destination",
    "VIP",
    "deck",
    "side",
    "group_id",
    "title",
    "deck_side",
]

# fill missing with 'Unknown'
for col in cat_cols_str:
    all_data[col] = all_data[col].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)

# create integer code versions for LightGBM (map strings to ints)
cat_col_code = {col: col + "_code" for col in cat_cols_str}
for col in cat_cols_str:
    all_data[cat_col_code[col]], _ = pd.factorize(all_data[col])

# ------------------------------ split back ------------------------------
base_train = all_data.iloc[: len(train)].reset_index(drop=True)
base_test = all_data.iloc[len(train) :].reset_index(drop=True)

# X_base_train (features only) – no target column exists, so direct copy
X_base_train = base_train.copy()
y_base = train["Transported"]  # boolean target

# list of all feature columns (including code cols) that we can input to LightGBM
feature_cols = numeric_cols + list(cat_col_code.values())

# list of categorical feature names for LightGBM (the integer code columns)
lgb_cat_cols = list(cat_col_code.values())


# ------------------------------ target encoding helper ------------------------------
def add_target_encoding(train_df, val_df, target_series, cat_cols, prior=5.0):
    """
    train_df : DataFrame with original features (contains only training rows)
    val_df   : DataFrame with same columns (validation or test rows)
    target_series : Series with target for train_df, aligned with train_df index
    cat_cols : list of column names (string) to encode
    prior    : smoothing parameter
    Returns (train_df, val_df) with new '_te' columns added.
    """
    target_name = target_series.name
    train_temp = train_df.copy()
    train_temp[target_name] = target_series.values

    global_mean = train_temp[target_name].mean()

    for col in cat_cols:
        stats = train_temp.groupby(col)[target_name].agg(["sum", "count"])
        stats["smooth"] = (stats["sum"] + prior * global_mean) / (
            stats["count"] + prior
        )
        mapping = stats["smooth"].to_dict()

        train_df[f"{col}_te"] = train_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
        val_df[f"{col}_te"] = val_df[col].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)

    return train_df, val_df


# ------------------------------ 5-fold CV with out-of-fold target encoding ------------------------------
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "binary_error",
    "boosting": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []
best_iters = []

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_base_train, y_base)):
    # split raw data
    X_tr_raw = X_base_train.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    X_val_raw = X_base_train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    y_tr = y_base.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    y_val = y_base.iloc[val_idx].copy()

    # out-of-fold target encoding
    X_tr_enc, X_val_enc = add_target_encoding(
        X_tr_raw, X_val_raw, y_tr, cat_cols_str, prior=5.0
    )

    # remove the string categorical columns (only keep code + new TE)
    X_tr_model = X_tr_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)
    X_val_model = X_val_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_model, label=y_tr, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val_model, label=y_val, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols, reference=dtrain
    )

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[dval],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50),
            lgb.log_evaluation(100),
        ],
    )

    best_iters.append(model.best_iteration)
    preds = (
        model.predict(X_val_model, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) > 0.5
    ).astype(bool)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, preds)
    accuracies.append(acc)

mean_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
mean_best_iter = int(np.mean(best_iters))

# ------------------------------ final target encoding on full train ------------------------------
X_full_raw = X_base_train.copy()
y_full = y_base.copy()

X_test_raw = base_test.copy()  # base_test already has all columns (no target)
X_full_enc, X_test_enc = add_target_encoding(
    X_full_raw, X_test_raw, y_full, cat_cols_str, prior=5.0
)

# drop string columns
X_full_model = X_full_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)
X_test_model = X_test_enc.drop(columns=cat_cols_str)

# ------------------------------ final model ------------------------------
dtrain_full = lgb.Dataset(X_full_model, label=y_full, categorical_feature=lgb_cat_cols)
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain_full,
    num_boost_round=mean_best_iter,
    valid_sets=[dtrain_full],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(100)],
)

test_proba = final_model.predict(X_test_model, num_iteration=mean_best_iter)
test_preds = test_proba > 0.5

# ------------------------------ submission ------------------------------
sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")
sub["Transported"] = np.where(test_preds, "True", "False")
sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

# ------------------------------ final output ------------------------------
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_acc:.4f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import optuna
import warnings
import sys
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./data/sample_submission.csv")

# Combine for consistent preprocessing
test["Transported"] = np.nan
combined = pd.concat([train, test], ignore_index=True)

# ------------------------------
# 2. Core preprocessing
# ------------------------------
# Parse PassengerId
combined[["group_id", "num_in_group"]] = combined["PassengerId"].str.split(
    "_", expand=True
)
combined["num_in_group"] = combined["num_in_group"].astype(int)

# Parse Cabin
cabin_split = combined["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
combined["deck"] = cabin_split[0]
combined["cabin_num"] = pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce")
combined["side"] = cabin_split[2]
combined["deck"] = combined["deck"].fillna("Unknown")
combined["cabin_num"] = combined["cabin_num"].fillna(-1)
combined["side"] = combined["side"].fillna("Unknown")

# Boolean columns -> int
bool_map = {True: 1, False: 0}
combined["CryoSleep"] = combined["CryoSleep"].map(bool_map)
combined["VIP"] = combined["VIP"].map(bool_map)

# Spending columns: fill NaN with 0, add missing indicators
spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
for col in spend_cols:
    combined[col + "_missing"] = combined[col].isna().astype(int)
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna(0.0)

# Infer CryoSleep: if total spend == 0 and CryoSleep missing, set to 1
total_spend = combined[spend_cols].sum(axis=1)
cryo_missing = combined["CryoSleep"].isna()
combined.loc[cryo_missing & (total_spend == 0), "CryoSleep"] = 1
combined["CryoSleep_missing"] = combined["CryoSleep"].isna().astype(int)
combined["CryoSleep"] = combined["CryoSleep"].fillna(0).astype(int)

# VIP missing -> 0
combined["VIP_missing"] = combined["VIP"].isna().astype(int)
combined["VIP"] = combined["VIP"].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Age: median fill + missing flag
global_median_age = combined["Age"].median()
combined["Age_missing"] = combined["Age"].isna().astype(int)
combined["Age"] = combined["Age"].fillna(global_median_age)

# Total spend
combined["total_spend"] = total_spend

# --- New features ---
# Spending ratios (with -1 to indicate zero total spend)
for col in spend_cols:
    combined[f"{col}_ratio"] = np.where(
        combined["total_spend"] > 0, combined[col] / combined["total_spend"], -1.0
    )
# Number of non-zero spending categories
combined["spend_diversity"] = (combined[spend_cols] > 0).sum(axis=1)
# Interaction: Age * total_spend
combined["age_x_total_spend"] = combined["Age"] * combined["total_spend"]

# --- Categorical encoding ---
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "deck", "side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna("Unknown")
    combined[col] = pd.factorize(combined[col])[0]

# --- Drop columns that won't be used in modelling ---
drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin", "Transported"]
raw_feature_columns = [c for c in combined.columns if c not in drop_cols]
model_features_base = [
    c for c in raw_feature_columns if c not in ["group_id", "num_in_group"]
]
categorical_features = [col for col in model_features_base if col in cat_cols]

# Group features that will be added by add_group_features
GROUP_FEATS = [
    "group_size",
    "group_mean_age",
    "group_std_age",
    "group_mean_total_spend",
    "group_std_total_spend",
    "group_transport_rate_smoothed",
]

# Separate back into train and test
train_processed = combined[combined["Transported"].notna()].copy()
test_processed = combined[combined["Transported"].isna()].copy()
train_y = train["Transported"].astype(int).values
train_processed["Transported"] = train_y

# Global fallbacks for group features (used when a group is unseen in a training fold)
global_mean_transport = train_y.mean()
global_mean_age = global_median_age
# Fixed: use combined mask to align with total_spend
global_mean_total_spend = total_spend[combined["Transported"].notna()].mean()
global_group_size = 1


# ------------------------------
# 3. Helper: add group-level features to a fold
# ------------------------------
def add_group_features(fold_df, train_df, smoothing=10):
    """
    Compute group statistics on 'train_df' and merge them into 'fold_df'.
    Both DataFrames must contain columns 'group_id', 'Age', 'total_spend', 'CryoSleep', etc.
    Returns fold_df with new columns, NOT the modified train_df.
    """
    gstats = (
        train_df.groupby("group_id")
        .agg(
            group_size=("group_id", "count"),
            group_mean_age=("Age", "mean"),
            group_std_age=("Age", "std"),
            group_mean_total_spend=("total_spend", "mean"),
            group_std_total_spend=("total_spend", "std"),
            group_transport_rate=("Transported", "mean"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    # Smoothed transport rate
    n = gstats["group_size"].values
    rate = gstats["group_transport_rate"].values
    smoothed = (n * rate + smoothing * global_mean_transport) / (n + smoothing)
    gstats["group_transport_rate_smoothed"] = smoothed
    gstats = gstats.drop(["group_transport_rate"], axis=1)

    # Fill NaN stds with 0 (if group size == 1)
    gstats["group_std_age"] = gstats["group_std_age"].fillna(0.0)
    gstats["group_std_total_spend"] = gstats["group_std_total_spend"].fillna(0.0)

    # Merge
    fold_df = fold_df.merge(gstats, on="group_id", how="left")

    # Fallback for unseen groups
    fold_df["group_size"] = fold_df["group_size"].fillna(global_group_size).astype(int)
    fold_df["group_mean_age"] = fold_df["group_mean_age"].fillna(global_mean_age)
    fold_df["group_std_age"] = fold_df["group_std_age"].fillna(0.0)
    fold_df["group_mean_total_spend"] = fold_df["group_mean_total_spend"].fillna(
        global_mean_total_spend
    )
    fold_df["group_std_total_spend"] = fold_df["group_std_total_spend"].fillna(0.0)
    fold_df["group_transport_rate_smoothed"] = fold_df[
        "group_transport_rate_smoothed"
    ].fillna(global_mean_transport)

    return fold_df


# ------------------------------
# 4. Optuna objective
# ------------------------------
def objective(trial):
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.2, log=True),
        "num_leaves": trial.suggest_int("num_leaves", 15, 127),
        "min_data_in_leaf": trial.suggest_int("min_data_in_leaf", 10, 100),
        "feature_fraction": trial.suggest_float("feature_fraction", 0.6, 1.0),
        "bagging_fraction": trial.suggest_float("bagging_fraction", 0.6, 1.0),
        "bagging_freq": trial.suggest_int("bagging_freq", 1, 10),
        "lambda_l1": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l1", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
        "lambda_l2": trial.suggest_float("lambda_l2", 1e-8, 10.0, log=True),
        "min_sum_hessian_in_leaf": trial.suggest_float(
            "min_sum_hessian_in_leaf", 1e-4, 100.0, log=True
        ),
        "seed": 42,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    accuracies = []
    for tr_idx, val_idx in skf.split(train_processed, train_y):
        train_fold = train_processed.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
        val_fold = train_processed.iloc[val_idx].copy()

        # Group features
        train_fold = add_group_features(train_fold, train_fold)
        val_fold = add_group_features(val_fold, train_fold)

        # Use base + group features
        feature_cols = model_features_base + GROUP_FEATS
        X_train = train_fold[feature_cols]
        y_train = train_fold["Transported"]
        X_val = val_fold[feature_cols]
        y_val = val_fold["Transported"]

        dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
            X_train,
            label=y_train,
            categorical_feature=categorical_features,
            params={"feature_pre_filter": False},
        )
        dval = lgb.Dataset(
            X_val,
            label=y_val,
            reference=dtrain,
            categorical_feature=categorical_features,
        )

        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtrain,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            valid_names=["val"],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)],
            num_boost_round=1000,
        )

        # Use best iteration for prediction
        pred_val = (
            model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) > 0.5
        ).astype(int)
        acc = accuracy_score(y_val, pred_val)
        accuracies.append(acc)

    return np.mean(accuracies)


# ------------------------------
# 5. Run Optuna study
# ------------------------------
optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
study = optuna.create_study(direction="maximize")
study.optimize(objective, n_trials=40, timeout=6000)

print(f"Best trial accuracy: {study.best_value:.4f}")
best_params = study.best_params
best_params.update(
    {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "seed": 42,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }
)

# ------------------------------
# 6. Final CV and test predictions with best params
# ------------------------------
N_SPLITS = 5
final_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=99)

val_scores = []
test_preds = np.zeros(len(test_processed))

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(final_skf.split(train_processed, train_y)):
    train_fold = train_processed.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    val_fold = train_processed.iloc[val_idx].copy()

    # Group features
    train_fold = add_group_features(train_fold, train_fold)
    val_fold = add_group_features(val_fold, train_fold)

    feature_cols = model_features_base + GROUP_FEATS
    X_train = train_fold[feature_cols]
    y_train = train_fold["Transported"]
    X_val = val_fold[feature_cols]
    y_val = val_fold["Transported"]

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
        X_train,
        label=y_train,
        categorical_feature=categorical_features,
        params={"feature_pre_filter": False},
    )
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val,
        label=y_val,
        reference=dtrain,
        categorical_feature=categorical_features,
    )

    model = lgb.train(
        best_params,
        dtrain,
        valid_sets=[dval],
        valid_names=["val"],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)],
        num_boost_round=1000,
    )

    # Validation accuracy using best iteration
    pred_val = (model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) > 0.5).astype(
        int
    )
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, pred_val)
    val_scores.append(acc)

    # Test predictions with best iteration
    test_fold = test_processed.copy()
    test_fold = add_group_features(test_fold, train_fold)
    X_test = test_fold[feature_cols]
    test_preds += model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) / N_SPLITS

# ------------------------------
# 7. Final output
# ------------------------------
mean_cv_acc = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"\nFINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_cv_acc:.4f}")

submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["Transported"] = (test_preds > 0.5).astype(bool)
submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold, GroupShuffleSplit
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import warnings
import optuna

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# =============================================================================
# 0. Constants and helpers
# =============================================================================
RANDOM_STATE = 42
N_FOLDS = 5
N_TRIALS_OPTUNA = 20
optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)

amenities_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]


def initial_preprocess(df, age_median=None):
    df = df.copy()
    df["group_id"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
    df["passenger_num"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[1].astype(int)

    cabin_split = df["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
    df["deck"] = cabin_split[0].fillna("Unknown")
    df["cabin_num"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    )
    df["side"] = cabin_split[2].fillna("Unknown")

    df["CryoSleep_num"] = (
        df["CryoSleep"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)
    )
    df["VIP_num"] = df["VIP"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)

    for col in amenities_cols:
        df[col + "_missing"] = df[col].isna().astype(int)
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0)

    df["Age_missing"] = df["Age"].isna().astype(int)
    if age_median is None and not df["Age"].isna().all():
        age_median = df["Age"].median()
    df["Age"] = df["Age"].fillna(age_median)

    for col in ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP"]:
        df[col] = df[col].fillna("Unknown")

    return df, age_median


def add_derived_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["spending_total"] = df[amenities_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["spending_active_count"] = (df[amenities_cols] > 0).sum(axis=1)

    for col in amenities_cols:
        df[col + "_log"] = np.log1p(df[col].clip(lower=0))
    df["spending_total_log"] = np.log1p(df["spending_total"].clip(lower=0))

    df["cryo_spend_conflict"] = (
        (df["CryoSleep_num"] == 1) & (df["spending_total"] > 0)
    ).astype(int)

    df["age_x_total_spend_log"] = df["Age"] * df["spending_total_log"]
    df["age_x_active_count"] = df["Age"] * df["spending_active_count"]

    df["vip_x_total_spend_log"] = df["VIP_num"] * df["spending_total_log"]

    age_bins = [-1, 12, 18, 30, 45, 60, 150]
    age_labels = ["child", "teen", "young_adult", "adult", "senior", "elder"]
    df["age_group"] = pd.cut(
        df["Age"], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, right=True
    ).astype(str)

    df["deck_dest"] = (df["deck"] + "_" + df["Destination"]).astype(str)

    df["is_leader"] = (df["passenger_num"] == 1).astype(int)

    return df


def compute_group_stats_dict(df, numeric_cols, group_col="group_id"):
    g = df.groupby(group_col)
    agg_funcs = {col: ["mean", "std", "count"] for col in numeric_cols}
    stats = g.agg(agg_funcs)
    stats.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in stats.columns.values]
    stats = stats.fillna(0)
    stats_dict = {}
    for idx, row in stats.iterrows():
        stats_dict[idx] = row.to_dict()
    default_stats = stats.mean().to_dict()
    return stats_dict, default_stats


def add_group_features(df, stats_dict, default_stats, group_col="group_id"):
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(stats_dict, orient="index").reset_index()
    stats_df.rename(columns={"index": group_col}, inplace=True)
    df = df.merge(stats_df, on=group_col, how="left")
    for col in stats_df.columns:
        if col != group_col:
            df[col] = df[col].fillna(default_stats[col])
    return df


class SafeLabelEncoder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.classes_ = set()

    def fit(self, series):
        self.classes_ = set(series.astype(str))

    def transform(self, series):
        s = series.astype(str)
        mapping = {c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(sorted(self.classes_))}
        return np.array([mapping.get(v, 0) for v in s], dtype=np.int64)

    def cardinality(self):
        return len(self.classes_) + 1

def get_lgb_params(trial):
    return {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.1, log=True),
        "num_leaves": trial.suggest_int("num_leaves", 15, 127),
        "feature_fraction": trial.suggest_float("feature_fraction", 0.6, 1.0),
        "bagging_fraction": trial.suggest_float("bagging_fraction", 0.6, 1.0),
        "bagging_freq": trial.suggest_int("bagging_freq", 1, 10),
        "max_bin": trial.suggest_int("max_bin", 128, 255),
        "verbose": -1,
        "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
        "num_threads": -1,
    }


def tune_lgb(X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val, cat_indices, n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA):
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
        X_train, label=y_train, categorical_feature=cat_indices, free_raw_data=False
    )
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_indices, free_raw_data=False
    )

    def objective(trial):
        params = get_lgb_params(trial)
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtrain,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        val_error = model.best_score["valid_0"]["binary_error"]
        return val_error

    study = optuna.create_study(direction="minimize")
    study.optimize(objective, n_trials=n_trials)
    return study.best_params


def get_xgb_params(trial):
    return {
        "objective": "binary:logistic",
        "eval_metric": "error",
        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.1, log=True),
        "max_depth": trial.suggest_int("max_depth", 3, 10),
        "subsample": trial.suggest_float("subsample", 0.6, 1.0),
        "colsample_bytree": trial.suggest_float("colsample_bytree", 0.6, 1.0),
        "tree_method": "gpu_hist" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "hist",
        "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
        "verbosity": 0,
    }


def tune_xgb(X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val, n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA):
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label=y_train)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)

    def objective(trial):
        params = get_xgb_params(trial)
        model = xgb.train(
            params,
            dtrain,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            evals=[(dval, "val")],
            early_stopping_rounds=50,
            verbose_eval=False,
        )
        val_error = model.best_score
        return val_error

    study = optuna.create_study(direction="minimize")
    study.optimize(objective, n_trials=n_trials)
    return study.best_params


class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        cat_cardinalities,
        emb_dims,
        num_numeric,
        hidden_units=[128, 64],
        dropout=0.3,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(c, d) for c, d in zip(cat_cardinalities, emb_dims)]
        )
        total_emb = sum(emb_dims)
        input_dim = total_emb + num_numeric
        layers = []
        for h in hidden_units:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(input_dim, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            input_dim = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(input_dim, 1))
        layers.append(nn.Sigmoid())
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, cat_data, num_data):
        embs = [emb(cat_data[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x = torch.cat(embs + [num_data], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze(1)


def train_nn(
    train_loader,
    val_loader,
    cat_cardinalities,
    num_numeric,
    device,
    epochs=30,
    lr=1e-3,
    weight_decay=1e-5,
    patience=5,
):
    emb_dims = [min(50, (c + 1) // 2 + 1) for c in cat_cardinalities]
    model = MLP(cat_cardinalities, emb_dims, num_numeric).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=weight_decay)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_epoch = 0
    best_state = None

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0.0
        for cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch in train_loader:
            cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch = (
                cat_batch.to(device),
                num_batch.to(device),
                y_batch.to(device),
            )
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
            loss = criterion(out, y_batch.float())
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item() * len(y_batch)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch in val_loader:
                cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch = (
                    cat_batch.to(device),
                    num_batch.to(device),
                    y_batch.to(device),
                )
                out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
                loss = criterion(out, y_batch.float())
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(y_batch)

        train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset) if val_loader else 0

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            best_state = model.state_dict()
        elif epoch - best_epoch >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    return model


def predict_nn(model, cat_data, num_data, batch_size=512, device="cuda"):
    model.eval()
    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(cat_data, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(num_data, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for cat_batch, num_batch in loader:
            cat_batch, num_batch = cat_batch.to(device), num_batch.to(device)
            out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
            preds.append(out.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds)


if HAS_CATBOOST:

    def train_catboost(
        X_train_pool,
        y_train,
        X_val_pool,
        y_val,
        iterations=1000,
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        task_type="GPU" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "CPU",
    ):
        model = catboost.CatBoostClassifier(
            iterations=iterations,
            learning_rate=0.05,
            depth=6,
            loss_function="Logloss",
            eval_metric="Accuracy",
            early_stopping_rounds=early_stopping_rounds,
            random_seed=RANDOM_STATE,
            verbose=False,
            task_type=task_type,
        )
        model.fit(
            X_train_pool,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val_pool, y_val),
            use_best_model=True,
        )
        return model

def main():
    # Load data
    train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

    age_med = train["Age"].median()
    train_proc, age_med = initial_preprocess(train, age_med)
    test_proc, _ = initial_preprocess(test, age_med)

    y = train_proc["Transported"].astype(int).values

    cat_cols_base = [
        "HomePlanet",
        "CryoSleep",
        "Destination",
        "VIP",
        "deck",
        "side",
        "age_group",
        "deck_dest",
    ]
    drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "Name", "Cabin", "Transported", "group_id"]

    # Storage for OOF predictions
    all_y_val = []
    all_pred_lgb = []
    all_pred_xgb = []
    all_pred_cb = []
    all_pred_nn = []

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}")

    groups = train_proc["group_id"].values
    kfold = GroupKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS)

    for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kfold.split(train_proc, y, groups)):
        print(f"Fold {fold+1}")
        fold_train = train_proc.iloc[train_idx].copy()
        fold_val = train_proc.iloc[val_idx].copy()
        y_train = y[train_idx]
        y_val = y[val_idx]

        # Feature engineering on each fold
        fold_train = add_derived_features(fold_train)
        fold_val = add_derived_features(fold_val)

        # Encode categoricals (fit on fold_train)
        encoders = {}
        for col in cat_cols_base:
            enc = SafeLabelEncoder()
            enc.fit(fold_train[col])
            fold_train[col] = enc.transform(fold_train[col])
            fold_val[col] = enc.transform(fold_val[col])
            encoders[col] = enc

        # Determine numeric columns (exclude ID, target, categoricals, group_id)
        all_feat_cols = [
            c
            for c in fold_train.columns
            if c not in drop_cols and not c.startswith("Transported")
        ]
        cat_cols_fold = cat_cols_base.copy()
        num_cols_fold = [c for c in all_feat_cols if c not in cat_cols_fold]

        # Group stats from fold_train
        stats_dict, default_stats = compute_group_stats_dict(
            fold_train, num_cols_fold, group_col="group_id"
        )
        fold_train = add_group_features(fold_train, stats_dict, default_stats)
        fold_val = add_group_features(fold_val, stats_dict, default_stats)

        # Final numeric columns after group stats
        ignore_cols = set(drop_cols + cat_cols_fold + ["group_id"])
        num_cols_final = [c for c in fold_train.columns if c not in ignore_cols]

        X_tr_num = fold_train[num_cols_final].values.astype(np.float32)
        X_val_num = fold_val[num_cols_final].values.astype(np.float32)
        X_tr_cat = fold_train[cat_cols_fold].values.astype(np.int64)
        X_val_cat = fold_val[cat_cols_fold].values.astype(np.int64)

        scaler = StandardScaler()
        X_tr_num = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr_num)
        X_val_num = scaler.transform(X_val_num)

        X_tr_full = np.concatenate([X_tr_num, X_tr_cat.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)
        X_val_full = np.concatenate([X_val_num, X_val_cat.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)

        cat_indices_lgb = list(
            range(len(num_cols_final), len(num_cols_final) + len(cat_cols_fold))
        )

        # Inner validation split for hyperparameter tuning
        inner_gss = GroupShuffleSplit(
            n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
        )
        inner_train_idx, inner_val_idx = next(
            inner_gss.split(fold_train, y_train, groups=fold_train["group_id"])
        )
        X_tr_inner = X_tr_full[inner_train_idx]
        y_tr_inner = y_train[inner_train_idx]
        X_val_inner = X_tr_full[inner_val_idx]
        y_val_inner = y_train[inner_val_idx]

        # --- LightGBM ---
        best_params_lgb = tune_lgb(
            X_tr_inner,
            y_tr_inner,
            X_val_inner,
            y_val_inner,
            cat_indices_lgb,
            n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA,
        )
        dtrain_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
            X_tr_full,
            label=y_train,
            categorical_feature=cat_indices_lgb,
            free_raw_data=False,
        )
        dval_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
            X_val_full,
            label=y_val,
            categorical_feature=cat_indices_lgb,
            free_raw_data=False,
        )
        model_lgb = lgb.train(
            best_params_lgb,
            dtrain_lgb,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dval_lgb],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        prob_lgb = model_lgb.predict(X_val_full, num_iteration=model_lgb.best_iteration)
        all_pred_lgb.append(prob_lgb)

        # --- XGBoost ---
        best_params_xgb = tune_xgb(
            X_tr_inner, y_tr_inner, X_val_inner, y_val_inner, n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA
        )
        dtrain_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr_full, label=y_train)
        dval_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_full, label=y_val)
        model_xgb = xgb.train(
            best_params_xgb,
            dtrain_xgb,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            evals=[(dval_xgb, "val")],
            early_stopping_rounds=50,
            verbose_eval=False,
        )
        prob_xgb = model_xgb.predict(
            xgb.DMatrix(X_val_full), iteration_range=(0, model_xgb.best_iteration + 1)
        )
        all_pred_xgb.append(prob_xgb)

        # --- CatBoost (only if available) ---
        if HAS_CATBOOST:
            cb_train_pool = catboost.Pool(
                X_tr_full, label=y_train, cat_features=cat_indices_lgb
            )
            cb_val_pool = catboost.Pool(
                X_val_full, label=y_val, cat_features=cat_indices_lgb
            )
            model_cb = train_catboost(cb_train_pool, y_train, cb_val_pool, y_val)
            prob_cb = model_cb.predict(X_val_full, prediction_type="Probability")[:, 1]
            all_pred_cb.append(prob_cb)

        # --- Neural Network ---
        cat_cardinalities = [encoders[col].cardinality() for col in cat_cols_fold]
        train_dataset = TensorDataset(
            torch.tensor(X_tr_cat, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(X_tr_num, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(y_train, dtype=torch.float32),
        )
        val_dataset = TensorDataset(
            torch.tensor(X_val_cat, dtype=torch.long),
            torch.tensor(X_val_num, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.float32),
        )
        train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
        val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=512, shuffle=False)
        model_nn = train_nn(
            train_loader,
            val_loader,
            cat_cardinalities,
            X_tr_num.shape[1],
            device,
            epochs=30,
            lr=1e-3,
            patience=5,
        )
        prob_nn = predict_nn(model_nn, X_val_cat, X_val_num, device=device)
        all_pred_nn.append(prob_nn)

        all_y_val.append(y_val)

    # ---- Compute overall OOF metrics ----
    y_val_stack = np.concatenate(all_y_val)
    prob_lgb_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_lgb)
    prob_xgb_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_xgb)
    prob_nn_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_nn)

    # Ensemble averaging (skip CatBoost if not present)
    if HAS_CATBOOST and all_pred_cb:
        prob_cb_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_cb)
        ensemble_prob = (
            prob_lgb_stack + prob_xgb_stack + prob_cb_stack + prob_nn_stack
        ) / 4.0
    else:
        ensemble_prob = (prob_lgb_stack + prob_xgb_stack + prob_nn_stack) / 3.0

    ensemble_pred = (ensemble_prob > 0.5).astype(int)
    cv_acc = accuracy_score(y_val_stack, ensemble_pred)

    # =============================================================================
    # 5. Final training on full dataset and test prediction
    # =============================================================================
    print("Training final models on full training set...")
    full_train = train_proc.copy()
    y_full = y

    full_train = add_derived_features(full_train)

    encoders_full = {}
    for col in cat_cols_base:
        enc = SafeLabelEncoder()
        enc.fit(full_train[col])
        full_train[col] = enc.transform(full_train[col])
        encoders_full[col] = enc

    temp_num_cols = [
        c
        for c in full_train.columns
        if c not in set(drop_cols + cat_cols_base + ["group_id"])
    ]

    stats_dict_full, default_stats_full = compute_group_stats_dict(
        full_train, temp_num_cols, group_col="group_id"
    )
    full_train = add_group_features(full_train, stats_dict_full, default_stats_full)

    final_ignore = set(drop_cols + ["group_id"] + cat_cols_base)
    num_cols_final_full = [c for c in full_train.columns if c not in final_ignore]
    cat_cols_final = cat_cols_base[:]

    X_num_full = full_train[num_cols_final_full].values.astype(np.float32)
    X_cat_full = full_train[cat_cols_final].values.astype(np.int64)
    scaler_full = StandardScaler()
    X_num_full = scaler_full.fit_transform(X_num_full)
    X_full = np.concatenate([X_num_full, X_cat_full.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)

    cat_indices_full = list(
        range(len(num_cols_final_full), len(num_cols_final_full) + len(cat_cols_final))
    )

    # Process test set
    test_proc_enc = test_proc.copy()
    test_proc_enc = add_derived_features(test_proc_enc)
    for col in cat_cols_base:
        test_proc_enc[col] = encoders_full[col].transform(test_proc_enc[col])

    test_proc_enc = add_group_features(
        test_proc_enc, stats_dict_full, default_stats_full
    )
    X_test_num = test_proc_enc[num_cols_final_full].values.astype(np.float32)
    X_test_cat = test_proc_enc[cat_cols_final].values.astype(np.int64)
    X_test_num = scaler_full.transform(X_test_num)
    X_test_full = np.concatenate([X_test_num, X_test_cat.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)

    # Inner split for tuning final models
    inner_gss_final = GroupShuffleSplit(
        n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )
    train_inner_idx, val_inner_idx = next(
        inner_gss_final.split(full_train, y_full, groups=full_train["group_id"])
    )
    X_full_inner = X_full[train_inner_idx]
    y_inner = y_full[train_inner_idx]
    X_val_inner = X_full[val_inner_idx]
    y_val_inner = y_full[val_inner_idx]

    # LightGBM final
    best_params_lgb_final = tune_lgb(
        X_full_inner,
        y_inner,
        X_val_inner,
        y_val_inner,
        cat_indices_full,
        n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA,
    )
    dtrain_full_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
        X_full, label=y_full, categorical_feature=cat_indices_full, free_raw_data=False
    )
    final_lgb = lgb.train(
        best_params_lgb_final,
        dtrain_full_lgb,
        num_boost_round=2000,
    )
    test_prob_lgb = final_lgb.predict(X_test_full)

    # XGBoost final
    best_params_xgb_final = tune_xgb(
        X_full_inner, y_inner, X_val_inner, y_val_inner, n_trials=N_TRIALS_OPTUNA
    )
    dtrain_full_xgb = xgb.DMatrix(X_full, label=y_full)
    final_xgb = xgb.train(
        best_params_xgb_final,
        dtrain_full_xgb,
        num_boost_round=2000,
    )
    test_prob_xgb = final_xgb.predict(xgb.DMatrix(X_test_full))

    # CatBoost final (if available)
    test_prob_cb = None
    if HAS_CATBOOST:
        cb_train_pool_full = catboost.Pool(
            X_full, label=y_full, cat_features=cat_indices_full
        )
        cb_val_pool = catboost.Pool(
            X_val_inner, label=y_val_inner, cat_features=cat_indices_full
        )
        model_cb_final = train_catboost(
            cb_train_pool_full, y_full, cb_val_pool, y_val_inner
        )
        test_prob_cb = model_cb_final.predict(
            X_test_full, prediction_type="Probability"
        )[:, 1]

    # Neural Network final
    cat_cardinalities_final = [
        encoders_full[col].cardinality() for col in cat_cols_final
    ]
    train_inner_nn = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_full_inner[:, len(num_cols_final_full) :], dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_full_inner[:, : len(num_cols_final_full)], dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_inner, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    val_inner_nn = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_val_inner[:, len(num_cols_final_full) :], dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_val_inner[:, : len(num_cols_final_full)], dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_val_inner, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    train_loader_final = DataLoader(train_inner_nn, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
    val_loader_final = DataLoader(val_inner_nn, batch_size=512, shuffle=False)
    final_nn = train_nn(
        train_loader_final,
        val_loader_final,
        cat_cardinalities_final,
        X_num_full.shape[1],
        device,
        epochs=50,
        lr=1e-3,
        patience=10,
    )
    test_prob_nn = predict_nn(final_nn, X_test_cat, X_test_num, device=device)

    # Ensemble predictions
    if HAS_CATBOOST and test_prob_cb is not None:
        test_ensemble_prob = (
            test_prob_lgb + test_prob_xgb + test_prob_cb + test_prob_nn
        ) / 4.0
    else:
        test_ensemble_prob = (test_prob_lgb + test_prob_xgb + test_prob_nn) / 3.0

    test_pred_bool = test_ensemble_prob > 0.5

    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {"PassengerId": test["PassengerId"].values, "Transported": test_pred_bool}
    )
    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission.csv")

    # FINAL line must be the cross-validation score
    print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_acc:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pandas as pd

# ========================= Define MLP model =========================
class MLPWithEmb(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, cat_dims, emb_size=10, num_feats=0, hidden=[128, 64], dropout=0.3
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(dim, min(50, (dim + 1) // 2)) for dim in cat_dims]
        )
        self.emb_out = sum([emb.embedding_dim for emb in self.embeddings])
        in_features = self.emb_out + num_feats
        layers = []
        for h in hidden:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(in_features, h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            in_features = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(in_features, 1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x_cat, x_num):
        embs = [emb(x_cat[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x_emb = torch.cat(embs, dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x_emb, x_num], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze(1)


# ========================= Training functions =========================
def train_lgb(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, categorical_feature=None):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=63,
        max_depth=-1,
        min_child_samples=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        random_state=SEED,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=1,
    )
    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        eval_metric="binary_logloss",
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False)],
        categorical_feature=categorical_feature,
    )
    return model


def train_xgb(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val):
    model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=6,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        objective="binary:logistic",
        eval_metric="logloss",
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        random_state=SEED,
        use_label_encoder=False,
        verbosity=0,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)
    return model


def train_mlp(
    X_cat_tr,
    X_num_tr,
    y_tr,
    X_cat_val,
    X_num_val,
    y_val,
    epochs=100,
    patience=10,
    lr=0.001,
):
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    model = MLPWithEmb(cat_dims=cat_dims, num_feats=X_num_tr.shape[1]).to(device)
    opt = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

    y_tr_t = torch.tensor(
        y_tr.values if hasattr(y_tr, "values") else y_tr, dtype=torch.float32
    ).to(device)
    y_val_t = torch.tensor(
        y_val.values if hasattr(y_val, "values") else y_val, dtype=torch.float32
    ).to(device)
    X_cat_tr_t = X_cat_tr.to(device)
    X_num_tr_t = X_num_tr.to(device)
    X_cat_val_t = X_cat_val.to(device)
    X_num_val_t = X_num_val.to(device)

    train_ds = TensorDataset(X_cat_tr_t, X_num_tr_t, y_tr_t)
    val_ds = TensorDataset(X_cat_val_t, X_num_val_t, y_val_t)
    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)

    best_loss = np.inf
    wait = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for xc, xn, yb in train_loader:
            opt.zero_grad()
            out = model(xc, xn)
            loss = criterion(out, yb)
            loss.backward()
            opt.step()

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for xc, xn, yb in val_loader:
                out = model(xc, xn)
                val_loss += criterion(out, yb).item() * len(yb)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)

        if val_loss < best_loss - 1e-4:
            best_loss = val_loss
            wait = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), "/tmp/best_mlp.pt")
        else:
            wait += 1
            if wait >= patience:
                break
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load("/tmp/best_mlp.pt"))
    return model


def predict_mlp_proba(model, X_cat, X_num):
    model.eval()
    device = next(model.parameters()).device
    if isinstance(X_cat, pd.DataFrame):
        X_cat_t = torch.tensor(X_cat.values, dtype=torch.long).to(device)
    else:
        X_cat_t = torch.tensor(X_cat, dtype=torch.long).to(device)
    X_num_t = torch.tensor(X_num, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(X_cat_t, X_num_t)
        proba = torch.sigmoid(logits).cpu().numpy()
    return proba


# ========================= 5-fold stacking =========================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

# ------ Train full models for test prediction ------

X_cat_full_t = X_mlp_cat_t.to(device)

train_ds_full = TensorDataset(X_cat_full_t, X_num_full_t, y_full_t)
train_loader_full = DataLoader(train_ds_full, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
best_loss = np.inf
patience = 10
wait = 0
for epoch in range(100):
    model_mlp_full.train()
    for xc, xn, yb in train_loader_full:
        opt.zero_grad()
        out = model_mlp_full(xc, xn)
        loss = criterion(out, yb)

        opt.step()

    # Evaluate on full training set using raw logits for valid early stopping
    model_mlp_full.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():

        full_loss = criterion(logits, y_full_t).item()

    if full_loss < best_loss - 1e-4:

        wait = 0
        torch.save(model_mlp_full.state_dict(), "/tmp/best_mlp_full.pt")
    else:
        wait += 1
        if wait >= patience:
            break

model_mlp_full.load_state_dict(torch.load("/tmp/best_mlp_full.pt"))
test_preds_mlp = predict_mlp_proba(model_mlp_full, X_test_mlp_cat, X_test_mlp_num)

# ========================= Stacking meta-model =========================
stack_X = np.column_stack([oof_lgb, oof_xgb, oof_mlp])
stack_y = y_train.values

meta = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=200, random_state=SEED)

import pandas as pd

import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from bayes_opt import BayesianOptimization
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Combine for consistent preprocessing (without target)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
combined = pd.concat(
    [train.drop("Transported", axis=1), test], axis=0, ignore_index=True
)

# Group features computed on the full (train+test) set – no leakage
combined[["group", "passenger_num"]] = combined["PassengerId"].str.split(
    "_", expand=True
)
combined["group"] = combined["group"].astype(int)
combined["passenger_num"] = combined["passenger_num"].astype(int)
group_counts = combined["group"].value_counts()
combined["group_size"] = combined["group"].map(group_counts)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Other feature engineering
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# --- Cabin ---
def extract_cabin(cabin):
    if isinstance(cabin, str):
        parts = cabin.split("/")
        deck = parts[0]
        num = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else np.nan
        side = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "Unknown"
        return deck, num, side
    return "Unknown", np.nan, "Unknown"


cabin_info = combined["Cabin"].apply(extract_cabin)
combined["cabin_deck"] = cabin_info.apply(lambda x: x[0])
combined["cabin_num"] = cabin_info.apply(lambda x: x[1])
combined["cabin_side"] = cabin_info.apply(lambda x: x[2])

# Convert cabin_num to float, fill missing
combined["cabin_num"] = combined["cabin_num"].astype(float).fillna(0)

# --- Spending ---
spend_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]
combined[spend_cols] = combined[spend_cols].fillna(0)
combined["total_spending"] = combined[spend_cols].sum(axis=1)

# --- CryoSleep imputation ---
missing_cryo = combined["CryoSleep"].isna()
combined["CryoSleep"] = combined["CryoSleep"].fillna(False)  # placeholder
combined.loc[missing_cryo & (combined["total_spending"] == 0), "CryoSleep"] = True
combined.loc[missing_cryo & (combined["total_spending"] > 0), "CryoSleep"] = False

# --- Age ---
combined["Age"] = combined["Age"].fillna(combined["Age"].median())

# --- Categorical missing imputation ---
for col in ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "VIP"]:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna(combined[col].mode().iloc[0])

# Cabin categoricals
combined["cabin_deck"] = combined["cabin_deck"].fillna("Unknown")
combined["cabin_side"] = combined["cabin_side"].fillna("Unknown")

# --- Boolean to int ---
combined["VIP"] = combined["VIP"].astype(int)
combined["CryoSleep"] = combined["CryoSleep"].astype(int)

# --- Set categorical columns to pandas category dtype ---
cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "cabin_deck", "cabin_side"]
for col in cat_cols:
    combined[col] = combined[col].astype("category")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Split back into train / test
# ------------------------------------------------------------
train_processed = combined.iloc[: len(train)].copy()
test_processed = combined.iloc[len(train) :].copy()
train_processed["Transported"] = train["Transported"].astype(int)

# Feature column list (excluding raw id / group / cabin; includes group_size)
feature_cols = [
    "group_size",
    "Age",
    "RoomService",
    "FoodCourt",
    "ShoppingMall",
    "Spa",
    "VRDeck",
    "total_spending",
    "cabin_num",
    "VIP",
    "CryoSleep",
    "passenger_num",
] + cat_cols

X = train_processed[feature_cols]
y = train_processed["Transported"]
X_test = test_processed[feature_cols]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Bayesian hyperparameter optimisation inside 5‑fold CV
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def lgb_cv_accuracy(
    num_leaves,
    max_depth,
    learning_rate,
    min_child_samples,
    subsample,
    colsample_bytree,
    reg_alpha,
    reg_lambda,
):
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": int(num_leaves),
        "max_depth": int(max_depth),
        "learning_rate": learning_rate,
        "min_child_samples": int(min_child_samples),
        "subsample": subsample,
        "colsample_bytree": colsample_bytree,
        "reg_alpha": reg_alpha,
        "reg_lambda": reg_lambda,
        "seed": 42,
        "verbose": -1,
        "feature_pre_filter": False,
        "device_type": "cpu",
    }

    cv_result = lgb.cv(
        params,
        lgb.Dataset(X, y, categorical_feature=cat_cols),
        num_boost_round=3000,
        nfold=5,
        stratified=True,
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        return_cvbooster=True,
    )
    best_error = min(cv_result["valid binary_error-mean"])
    acc = 1.0 - best_error
    return acc


# Parameter bounds
pbounds = {
    "num_leaves": (7, 255),
    "max_depth": (3, 12),
    "learning_rate": (0.005, 0.2),
    "min_child_samples": (5, 100),
    "subsample": (0.5, 1.0),
    "colsample_bytree": (0.3, 1.0),
    "reg_alpha": (0.0, 10.0),
    "reg_lambda": (0.0, 10.0),
}

optimizer = BayesianOptimization(
    f=lgb_cv_accuracy,
    pbounds=pbounds,
    random_state=42,
)

# Helper to extract group id and passenger number
def initial_preprocess(df, age_median=None):
    df = df.copy()
    df["group_id"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
    df["passenger_num"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[1].astype(int)

    # Cabin: deck, num, side
    cabin_split = df["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)
    df["deck"] = cabin_split[0].fillna("Unknown")
    df["cabin_num"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(cabin_split[1], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    )
    df["side"] = cabin_split[2].fillna("Unknown")

    # Binary columns to numeric (use for group stats later)
    df["CryoSleep_num"] = (
        df["CryoSleep"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)
    )
    df["VIP_num"] = df["VIP"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Amenities missing indicators + fill with 0
    for col in ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]:
        df[col + "_missing"] = df[col].isna().astype(int)
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0)

    # Age: missing indicator and fill
    df["Age_missing"] = df["Age"].isna().astype(int)
    if age_median is None:
        age_median = df["Age"].median()
    df["Age"] = df["Age"].fillna(age_median)

    # Categorical fills
    for col in ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP"]:
        df[col] = df[col].fillna("Unknown")

    return df, age_median

base_numeric_for_group = [
    "passenger_num",

def compute_group_stats_df(df, numeric_cols, group_col="group_id"):
    g = df.groupby(group_col)
    agg_funcs = {col: ["mean", "std", "count"] for col in numeric_cols}
    stats = g.agg(agg_funcs)
    stats.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in stats.columns.values]
    stats = stats.fillna(0)  # std of single-member groups -> 0

    stats_dict = {}
    for idx, row in stats.iterrows():
        stats_dict[idx] = row.to_dict()
    default_stats = stats.mean().to_dict()
    return stats_dict, default_stats


def add_group_features(df, stats_dict, default_stats, group_col="group_id"):
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(stats_dict, orient="index").reset_index()
    stats_df.rename(columns={"index": group_col}, inplace=True)
    df = df.merge(stats_df, on=group_col, how="left")
    for col in stats_df.columns:
        if col != group_col:
            df[col] = df[col].fillna(default_stats[col])
    return df


# =============================================================================
# 3. Categorical encoding (safe for unseen categories)
# =============================================================================
class SafeLabelEncoder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.classes_ = set()

    def fit(self, series):
        self.classes_ = set(series.astype(str))

    def transform(self, series):
        s = series.astype(str)
        mapping = {
            c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(sorted(self.classes_))
        }  # 0 for unknown
        return np.array([mapping.get(v, 0) for v in s], dtype=np.int64)

    def cardinality(self):
        return len(self.classes_) + 1  # including 0


cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "CryoSleep", "Destination", "VIP", "deck", "side"]

# 4. Model definitions
# =============================================================================
def train_lgb(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_val,
    y_val,
    cat_indices,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    early_stop_rounds=50,
):
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(
        X_train, label=y_train, categorical_feature=cat_indices, free_raw_data=False
    )
    dval = lgb.Dataset(
        X_val, label=y_val, categorical_feature=cat_indices, free_raw_data=False
    )
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_error",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 64,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "max_bin": 255,
        "verbose": -1,
        "random_state": 42,
    }
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=num_boost_round,
        valid_sets=[dtrain, dval],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(early_stop_rounds), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    return model


def train_xgb(
    X_train, y_train, X_val, y_val, num_boost_round=1000, early_stop_rounds=50
):
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label=y_train)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)
    params = {
        "objective": "binary:logistic",
        "eval_metric": "error",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "max_depth": 6,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "tree_method": "gpu_hist" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "hist",
        "random_state": 42,
    }
    model = xgb.train(
        params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=num_boost_round,
        evals=[(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "val")],
        early_stopping_rounds=early_stop_rounds,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    return model


class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        cat_cardinalities,
        emb_dims,
        num_numeric,
        hidden_units=[128, 64],
        dropout=0.3,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(c, d) for c, d in zip(cat_cardinalities, emb_dims)]
        )
        total_emb = sum(emb_dims)
        input_dim = total_emb + num_numeric
        layers = []
        for h in hidden_units:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(input_dim, h))
            layers.append(nn.BatchNorm1d(h))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
            layers.append(nn.Dropout(dropout))
            input_dim = h
        layers.append(nn.Linear(input_dim, 1))
        layers.append(nn.Sigmoid())
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, cat_data, num_data):
        embs = [emb(cat_data[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.embeddings)]
        x = torch.cat(embs + [num_data], dim=1)
        return self.net(x).squeeze(1)


def train_nn(
    train_loader,
    val_loader,
    cat_cardinalities,
    num_numeric,
    device,
    epochs=30,
    lr=1e-3,
    weight_decay=1e-5,
    patience=5,
):
    emb_dims = [min(50, (c + 1) // 2 + 1) for c in cat_cardinalities]
    model = MLP(cat_cardinalities, emb_dims, num_numeric).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=weight_decay)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_epoch = 0
    best_state = None

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0.0
        for cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch in train_loader:
            cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch = (
                cat_batch.to(device),
                num_batch.to(device),
                y_batch.to(device),
            )
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
            loss = criterion(out, y_batch.float())
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item() * len(y_batch)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch in val_loader:
                cat_batch, num_batch, y_batch = (
                    cat_batch.to(device),
                    num_batch.to(device),
                    y_batch.to(device),
                )
                out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
                loss = criterion(out, y_batch.float())
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(y_batch)

        train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset) if val_loader else 0

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch
            best_state = model.state_dict()
        elif epoch - best_epoch >= patience:
            break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    return model


def predict_nn(model, cat_data, num_data, batch_size=512, device="cuda"):
    model.eval()
    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(cat_data, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(num_data, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for cat_batch, num_batch in loader:
            cat_batch, num_batch = cat_batch.to(device), num_batch.to(device)
            out = model(cat_batch, num_batch)
            preds.append(out.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds)


# =============================================================================
# 5. Cross-validation loop

groups = train_proc["group_id"].values
kfold = GroupKFold(n_splits=5)
all_y_val, all_pred_lgb, all_pred_xgb, all_pred_nn = [], [], [], []

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kfold.split(train_proc, y, groups)):

    # Compute group stats on fold_train

    )

    # Encode categoricals (fit on fold_train)
    encoders = {}
    for col in cat_cols:

        enc.fit(fold_train[col])

    # Prepare feature matrices
    X_tr_num = fold_train[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    X_val_num = fold_val[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_tr_num = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr_num)
    X_val_num = scaler.transform(X_val_num)

    # LightGBM
    full_cols = (
        num_cols + cat_cols
    )  # cat encoded as int, but LGBM will treat specified columns as categorical
    cat_indices_lgb = [i for i, col in enumerate(full_cols) if col in cat_cols]
    X_tr_lgb = np.concatenate([X_tr_num, X_tr_cat.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)
    X_val_lgb = np.concatenate([X_val_num, X_val_cat.astype(np.float32)], axis=1)
    model_lgb = train_lgb(

        y_val,

    )
    prob_lgb = model_lgb.predict(X_val_lgb, num_iteration=model_lgb.best_iteration)
    all_pred_lgb.append(prob_lgb)

    # XGBoost
    model_xgb = train_xgb(
        X_tr_lgb, y_train, X_val_lgb, y_val, num_boost_round=1000, early_stop_rounds=50
    )
    prob_xgb = model_xgb.predict(
        xgb.DMatrix(X_val_lgb), iteration_range=(0, model_xgb.best_iteration + 1)
    )
    all_pred_xgb.append(prob_xgb)

    # Neural network
    cat_cardinalities = [encoders[col].cardinality() for col in cat_cols]
    train_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_tr_cat, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_tr_num, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_train, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    val_dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_val_cat, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(X_val_num, dtype=torch.float32),
        torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.float32),
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=512, shuffle=False)
    model_nn = train_nn(
        train_loader,
        val_loader,
        cat_cardinalities,
        X_tr_num.shape[1],
        device,
        epochs=30,
        lr=1e-3,
        patience=5,
    )
    prob_nn = predict_nn(model_nn, X_val_cat, X_val_num, device=device)
    all_pred_nn.append(prob_nn)

    all_y_val.append(y_val)

# Ensemble accuracy
y_val_stack = np.concatenate(all_y_val)
prob_lgb_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_lgb)
prob_xgb_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_xgb)
prob_nn_stack = np.concatenate(all_pred_nn)
ensemble_prob = (prob_lgb_stack + prob_xgb_stack + prob_nn_stack) / 3.0
ensemble_pred = (ensemble_prob > 0.5).astype(int)
cv_acc = accuracy_score(y_val_stack, ensemble_pred)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {cv_acc:.4f}")

print("Training final models on full training set...")
# Preprocess full training set

cat_cardinalities_final = [encoders_full[col].cardinality() for col in cat_cols]

emb_dims_final = [min(50, (c + 1) // 2 + 1) for c in cat_cardinalities_final]
final_nn = MLP(cat_cardinalities_final, emb_dims_final, X_num_full.shape[1]).to(device)

def preprocess(df, is_train, impute_vals=None):
    df = df.copy()

    # Group size
    df["GroupId"] = df["PassengerId"].str.split("_").str[0]
    df["GroupSize"] = df.groupby("GroupId")["PassengerId"].transform("count")

    # Cabin decomposition
    cabin_split = df["Cabin"].str.split("/", expand=True)

    df["VIP"] = df["VIP"].map({"True": 1, "False": 0}).fillna(0).astype(int)

    amenity_cols = ["RoomService", "FoodCourt", "ShoppingMall", "Spa", "VRDeck"]

    # CryoSleep inconsistency feature (before spending correction)
    df["CryoInconsistent"] = (
        (df["CryoSleep"] == 1) & (df[amenity_cols].gt(0).any(axis=1))
    ).astype(int)
    # Enforce zero spending for cryosleep
    for c in amenity_cols:
        df.loc[df["CryoSleep"] == 1, c] = 0

    # Missingness indicators (before any imputation)
    missing_cols = [
        "Age",
        "RoomService",
        "FoodCourt",
        "ShoppingMall",
        "Spa",
        "VRDeck",
        "CabinNum",
        "Deck",
        "Side",
        "HomePlanet",
        "Destination",
    ]
    for c in missing_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c + "_missing"] = df[c].isna().astype(int)

    # Imputation values (computed only on train)
    if is_train:
        impute_vals = {}
        impute_vals["Age"] = df["Age"].median()
        impute_vals["CabinNum"] = df["CabinNum"].median()
        for c in amenity_cols:
            impute_vals[c] = 0.0
        for c in ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side"]:
            impute_vals[c] = (
                df[c].mode().iloc[0] if not df[c].mode().empty else "missing"
            )
    else:
        pass

    # Apply imputations
    df["Age"] = df["Age"].fillna(impute_vals["Age"])
    df["CabinNum"] = df["CabinNum"].fillna(impute_vals["CabinNum"])
    for c in amenity_cols:
        df[c] = df[c].fillna(impute_vals.get(c, 0.0))
    for c in ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side"]:
        df[c] = df[c].fillna(impute_vals[c])

    # One‑hot encode low‑cardinality categoricals
    cat_cols = ["HomePlanet", "Destination", "Deck", "Side"]
    df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=cat_cols, prefix=cat_cols, dummy_na=False)

    # Drop columns not needed for modelling
    drop_cols = ["PassengerId", "GroupId", "Name", "Cabin"]
    df.drop(columns=[c for c in drop_cols if c in df.columns], inplace=True)

    if is_train:
        impute_vals["_feature_names"] = df.columns.tolist()
        return df, impute_vals
    else:
        # Align test columns with training
        feature_names = impute_vals["_feature_names"]
        for c in feature_names:
            if c not in df.columns:
                df[c] = 0
        df = df[feature_names]
        return df


# Apply preprocessing
y = train["Transported"].astype(bool)
X_train, impute_vals = preprocess(train.drop("Transported", axis=1), is_train=True)
X_test = preprocess(test, is_train=False, impute_vals=impute_vals)
assert list(X_train.columns) == list(X_test.columns), "Feature mismatch!"

# ──────────────── 5‑fold CV with early stopping ─────────────────────
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
accuracies = []

for train_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X_train, y):
    X_tr, X_val = X_train.iloc[train_idx], X_train.iloc[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

    # Inner split for early stopping
    X_inner, X_es, y_inner, y_es = train_test_split(
        X_tr, y_tr, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_tr
    )

    # LightGBM
    lgbm = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        boosting_type="gbdt",
        num_leaves=31,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        feature_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_freq=5,
        verbose=-1,
        random_state=42,
        n_estimators=5000,
    )
    lgbm.fit(
        X_inner,
        y_inner,
        eval_set=[(X_es, y_es)],
        eval_metric="binary_error",
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100)],
    )

    # XGBoost
    xgbm = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        objective="binary:logistic",
        eval_metric="error",
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        n_estimators=5000,
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        random_state=42,
        verbosity=0,
    )
    xgbm.fit(X_inner, y_inner, eval_set=[(X_es, y_es)], verbose=False)

    # HistGradientBoosting (internal early stopping)
    hgb = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
        max_iter=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=6,
        random_state=42,
        early_stopping=True,
        n_iter_no_change=20,
        validation_fraction=0.15,
    )
    hgb.fit(X_tr, y_tr)  # uses internal validation split

    # Ensemble predictions (soft voting)
    prob_lgb = lgbm.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    prob_xgb = xgbm.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    prob_hgb = hgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    prob_avg = (prob_lgb + prob_xgb + prob_hgb) / 3.0
    pred = prob_avg > 0.5
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, pred)
    accuracies.append(acc)

mean_cv_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
print(f"FINAL_VALIDATION_SCORE: {mean_cv_acc}")

# ──────────────── Final model on full training data ─────────────────────
# Split for final early stopping
X_tr_full, X_es_full, y_tr_full, y_es_full = train_test_split(
    X_train, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

lgb_final = lgb.LGBMClassifier(

xgb_final = xgb.XGBClassifier(

# Retrain with best iterations and full data
